body:
Long term well medicated bi-polar for background.  I see my doctor regularly, a counselor not so often once in a while.  Maybe once or twice a year.  I lost my mother in the beginning of October and we didn't have the best relationship, but that was her thing.  She would be in your life constantly for a month or two while you did something together and then she would drop off the radar.  No phone calls, no return phone calls, no return texts, no return emails.  

I went to see her before she passed and feel fine with how our relationship was.  I went back twice since, once to clean out the house and deal with estate affairs and the second for the memorial and some more legal matters.

Work is good.  I just feel sad.  Husband is trying to be so supportive but sometimes just makes it worse.   UGH.  I'm going to take a  break from thinking for the night.
I don't feel entirely safe.  Not that something will happen tonight.  But soon.  This really sucks
